svg.title: Rubi: PS Vita in-game controls
svg.desc: Default controls: L plus R opens or closes Rubi. Select plus R toggles the subtitle strip. D-pad left and right move by matched word, or by character in Character mode. Up and Down move between text rows; Up at the top opens earlier dialogue in Automatic reading mode, and Down past the last row of an earlier line moves toward the live text. The left stick moves by character horizontally and by text row vertically, stopping at the current text's ends. The right stick scrolls definitions. Tap a recognized character on the front touchscreen to look up its word. Triangle toggles reading statistics and the hook or OCR text source. Square opens the dialogue-region editor; hold Square for one second to restore the full screen. Enter saves the selected Anki card when Card mining is on. Cancel closes Rubi. Enter and Cancel follow the Vita's system setting: usually cross and circle respectively, but they can be swapped. PS closes Rubi and opens LiveArea. Double-tap the rear touchpad while Rubi is open for one full-screen OCR scan without changing the saved region. In the region editor, move with the left stick or D-pad, press Enter at the first corner, move to the opposite corner and press Enter to save; alternatively drag on the front screen, then press Enter. Cancel undoes the first corner or exits the editor. Hold L while launching a game to skip Rubi for that launch. The opening and subtitle shortcuts can be remapped in config.ini.
svg.metadata: Control mappings checked against docs/guide.md, core/config.c, core/buttons.h, core/region_select.c, shell/overlay.cpp and kernel/input.c at cc7ba80a. Device artwork adapted from docs/promo/assets/device/vita-white.svg (original vector drawing, CC0-1.0; provenance in docs/promo/assets/SOURCES.md). All artwork is inline vector; no external images, fonts or scripts are required.
